expectedRoute.rationale: The target is a consumer financial technology company with partner-bank products, purchase volume and active-member metrics.

binaryClaims.statement: Chime had filed a Form S-1 by the 2025-05-13 cutoff.
Chime's IPO share count and price range were known at the 2025-05-13 cutoff.
Chime itself was a bank as of the cutoff.

observableClaims.statement: Chime had 8.6 million Active Members as of 2025-03-31.
Q1 2025 Purchase Volume was USD 34.540 billion.
Chime reported a USD 25.3 million net loss for 2024.

expectedAbstentions.description: IPO pricing and fully diluted value were published after the cutoff and may be used only as gold scoring targets.
The S-1 does not provide a security-level fair-value target for private shares at the cutoff.

mustNotConflate: IPO gross proceeds with total equity value
fully diluted IPO equity value with enterprise value
public IPO price with private security-level fair value
valuationSeparationExpectations.notes: Historical valuation scoring is limited to the annotated fully diluted IPO equity-value reference.

completenessExpectations.description: A complete answer should cover S-1 status, partner-bank model, active members, purchase volume, IPO pricing unknown at cutoff and post-cutoff leakage.

historicalValuationTargets.reason: Manifest permits historical valuation-error scoring only for the IPO equity-value reference.

targets.scoringNotes: Use as a historical equity-value reference only; do not treat it as enterprise value or security-level fair value.
